# D3. Replication {#rep}

Every table and figure of this appendix is produced by the pipeline in `python/paper` of the
[repository](https://github.com/ChampionApe/SSDclaude), in three stages: the calibrations, the experiments, and a
build that reads only their results and writes the exhibits in seconds. `REPLICATION.md` in the repository maps the
data and the code to every output, with the commands and the time each stage takes; the technical documentation
[@BergGE26doc] describes the model, its equilibria and the algorithms. The interactive figures draw from csv files
that the build writes from the same results, and each figure's *Data* link downloads its file.

The table lists every exhibit of this appendix, the output that holds it, the builder that makes it and the results
files it reads; each exhibit's *Source* has the same, with the command that rebuilds it.
